purpose: Teach: 申し込み/専攻/子会社/持ち主/一環/一括/圧縮/復旧

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 採用、本気で、絶対、申し込み、絶対、件数、絶対、増えていますね
lines.en: The number of applications we're receiving is increasing significantly.
lines.style: Brisk, forward-moving pace. Alert and engaged tone. Crisp attack on the opening word. Professional but not distant. Sounds like someone bringing good news to a meeting.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。応募者の、本気で、絶対、専攻、絶対、分野、絶対、多様化、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're seeing good diversity in the applicants' backgrounds and fields of study.
lines.style: Cooperative and affirming. Measured pace with slight warmth. Nods along with the words. Supportive without overselling. The tone of someone building on what was just said.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 関連の、本気で、絶対、子会社、絶対、業績、絶対、確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's check in on how our subsidiary companies are performing.
lines.style: Clear directive. Slight lean forward in the voice. Purposeful pace. Gentle but unmistakably steering the conversation toward action. Not commanding, suggesting.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規取引先の、本気で、絶対、持ち主、絶対、お会いしてきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've actually met with the new partner's owner already.
lines.style: Informative and slightly proud. Straightforward delivery. Small lift at 'met' — a note of accomplishment without boasting. Steady, reliable tone.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社会貢献の、本気で、絶対、一環、絶対、地域イベント、絶対、協賛しましょう
lines.en: As part of our social responsibility efforts, let's sponsor the upcoming local events.
lines.style: Purposeful direction with underlying genuine commitment. Slightly slower pace here — this matters. Warm but professional. Open, inclusive 'let's' that brings him in.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新システムの、本気で、絶対、一括、絶対、購入、絶対、検討しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're currently considering bulk purchasing the new system platform.
lines.style: Cooperative update. Steady, deliberate pace. Calm and thorough. The tone of someone who has already thought this through and is reporting progress, not scrambling.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: データの、本気で、絶対、圧縮、絶対、保存、絶対、検討しましょう
lines.en: We should think through data compression and archival strategies.
lines.style: Reflective and thoughtful. Slightly longer pauses between clauses. Not rushed. Tone suggests she's weighing options. Invites consideration rather than declares.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。バックアップから、本気で、絶対、復旧、絶対、確認、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're confirming that all backup and recovery systems are working properly.
lines.style: Reassuring close. Calm, steady pace. Professional confidence without tension. The tone of someone tying up loose ends thoughtfully. Slight warmth that says 'all is well in hand.'
